description: A coupled tractor-trailer: `opts.cab` and `opts.trailer` pick the pieces, the trailer's kingpin sits over the fifth wheel.

name: boxTruck
description: Class 6 box truck: conventional cab and a 26 ft dry box with a roll-up rear door.

name: pickup
description: Full-size crew-cab pickup, 5.9 m × 2.03 m × 1.95 m, 1.65 m bed.

name: sedan
description: Mid-size sedan, 4.9 m × 1.85 m × 1.45 m.

name: cargoVan
description: High-roof full-size cargo van, 5.93 m × 2.05 m × 2.75 m.

name: deliveryVan
description: Right-hand-drive walk-in delivery van, 4.6 m × 2.02 m × 2.42 m, the carrier's own kind of postal delivery vehicle rather than any manufacturer's: the driver's seat is on the kit's -x side and the single wide door slides open on that same side, so a carrier working a route of curbside boxes steps straight onto the curb without ever crossing behind or in front of the van into the travel lane.

name: ambulance
description: Type III ambulance: cutaway van cab and a modular patient box, 7.0 m × 2.4 m × 3.0 m.

name: fireEngine
description: Pumper fire engine on a custom cab: 10.2 m × 2.5 m × 3.3 m.

name: bucketTruck
description: Insulated aerial device on a Class 7 utility body: 9.6 m × 2.5 m × 3.7 m stowed.

name: busTransit
description: 40 ft low-floor transit bus: 12.2 m × 2.59 m × 3.25 m to the roof pod.

name: schoolBus
description: Yellow school bus, Type C conventional: a truck-chassis hood and cab ahead of a bench-seat body, one continuous roofline, National School Bus Glossy Yellow with a black roof cap and skirt, "SCHOOL BUS" lettered on the side and rear.

name: forkliftCounterbalance
description: Counterbalance forklift, 5,000 lb LPG class: 2.3 m truck + 1.07 m forks, 1.15 m wide, overhead guard 2.15 m, mast lowered 2.1 m.

name: yardHustler
description: Terminal tractor (yard hustler): single-seat cab offset to the left, lifting fifth wheel, rear catwalk.

name: workboat
description: Small aluminium workboat: 7.6 m × 2.6 m, keel at y 0, wheelhouse to 3.1 m with mast.

name: motorYacht
description: Mid-size motor yacht: 24 m × 6 m, keel at y 0, main deck at 2.4 m, flybridge at 4.7 m, radar arch and mast light to 8 m.

name: yachtTender
description: Rigid inflatable yacht tender: 4.2 m × 1.9 m, keel at y 0, tubes to 0.75 m, console to 1.2 m, one outboard on the transom.

name: skiff
description: Aluminium centre-console skiff: 5.2 m × 2.0 m, keel at y 0, gunwale at about 0.8 m, console and grab rail to 1.4 m, one outboard on the transom.

name: deckBarge
description: Flat steel deck barge, 16 m × 6 m × 1.8 m deep, raked both ends, four double bitts and a side ladder; `opts.kind: "hopper"` adds a lined sediment hopper — a coaming round the hold with a watertight liner and a load that a station raises as it fills (`load.scale.y`).

name: deckBarge:hopper
description: Flat steel deck barge, 16 m × 6 m × 1.8 m deep, raked both ends, four double bitts and a side ladder; `opts.kind: "hopper"` adds a lined sediment hopper — a coaming round the hold with a watertight liner and a load that a station raises as it fills (`load.scale.y`).

name: salvageCraneBarge
description: Salvage crane barge: an 18 m spud barge carrying a revolving lattice-boom crane aft, its boom luffed over the bow.

name: skimmerVessel
description: Debris and oil skimming vessel: an 11 m aluminium catamaran with a bow conveyor that lowers into the water and carries floating debris up into a collection basket, two sweep arms that swing out to funnel a slick or a trash line to the bow, a recovered-product tank with its hatch, and the wheelhouse aft.

name: deckCrane
description: Marine knuckle-boom deck crane, pedestal mounted, for a workboat's or a barge's deck: slewing column, main boom, knuckle jib and hook on its fall, with the operator's lever bank on the pedestal.

name: derelictBoat
description: A derelict fibreglass sailboat, 9 m, dismasted, the kind that drags its anchor onto a mudflat or sinks at a mooring: faded gelcoat, a band of marine growth at the waterline, a stump of mast, open companionway, bow and stern cleats, a fuel vent on the quarter, and two marked sling points where a salvage rigger passes the lifting slings.

name: spudBarge
description: Sectional spud barge, the small flat-deck work barge a bay restoration job floats an excavator or a sediment load on: three bolted sections, 12.2 m by 6.1 m by 1.5 m deep, a raked bow at +Z, a sealed spill coaming round the deck so wet sediment drains to the deck's own sump rather than over the side, two spud wells at the stern with their spuds (raised; lower them by moving each spud's y down by up to `userData.lift`), four mooring bitts and sidelights for when a tug has it alongside.

name: rov
description: Observation-class ROV: 0.9 m long, 0.62 m wide, 0.5 m tall, an open aluminium frame under a yellow syntactic-foam flotation block, a camera dome forward, two LED lamps beside it, four thrusters (two horizontal aft, two vertical), a single-function manipulator jaw forward-low and a tether termination on top.
